messages:
eng-oncall-bot: Pager summary from last night: svc-rt-inference high tail latency -> paging to primary oncall at 02:14 UTC. Auto-escalation to SRE after 10m. :rotating_light:
Alex: saw the pager, joined call. We mitigated by shifting traffic to fallback region and restarting the model pool. Latency dropped ~85% after restart.
Sam: yep, confirmed. Root cause looked like KV cache fragmentation on the quantized path; memory pressure + long GC on the runtime thread.
Maria: customer impact: a handful of paid customers saw 500s for short bursts (~14 minutes peak). CS reported 5 incoming tickets, raised a priority support case for 2 enterprise tenants.
Jess: thanks. Can we set a quick postmortem? I'm blocked on a few follow-ups and want to lock owners.
Alex: +1. Proposal: postmortem tomorrow (UTC-friendly) at 16:00 UTC. Duration 45m. Agenda: timeline, impact, root cause, immediate fixes, action items, follow-up tracking.
Sam: works for me. Can @Maria own the impact summary and customer outreach notes?
Maria: I can. I'll collate ticket IDs and add short blurbs from CS.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: link to incident timeline: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2029 (auto-created)
Alex: quick ask for the thread — can we capture the follow-ups in a tracker automatically? Right now we manually create JIRA issues and it's easy to lose things.
Jess: agreed. I've been poking at a lightweight action-tracker dashboard idea in the internal ops app. Could the bot create items with a template when a postmortem is scheduled?
Sam: we also need standardized severity and customer-impact tags so the tracker can sort urgent customer-facing work.
Maria: proposed template for actions (one-liners):
```
- Action: Short title
- Owner: @handle
- Due: YYYY-MM-DD
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- Context: one sentence
- Verification: how to confirm
```
Alex: love it. Can eng-oncall-bot auto-populate items from the postmortem agenda and assign a default review cadence?
eng-oncall-bot: here's a rough webhook payload I was thinking of for auto-ticket creation: ```POST /api/actions {"title":"<summary>","owner":"<user>","due":"<date>","severity":"P1","incident":"INC-2029"}```
Jess: small nit: include a field for "release_blocker: true/false" to allow product to triage. Also add "customer_impact: " with short enum (none/minor/major/critical).
Sam: next step: I'll prototype a lambda that listens to postmortem creation and calls the tracker API. Want to include a small dedupe step using incident ID.
Alex: assign prototype to Sam, due EOD Fri. Sam will also add a flag to optionally create follow-up reminders at 7/30/90 days.
Sam: noted. I'll post PR to ops repo and drop a link here when ready.
Maria: for the immediate technical remediation — I'm adding these actions:
- Alex: roll out runtime patch to reduce KV cache fragmentation config (due in 3 days)
- Sam: add observability metric for KV map size + allocation spikes (due in 5 days)
- Jess: add dashboard panel and alert for backend GC stall > 2s (due in 2 days)
eng-oncall-bot: action items created in tracker: ACT-8421, ACT-8422, ACT-8423 (auto-note).
Alex: can we add a postmortem template tweak: require a short customer-facing blurb under "impact summary" so CS can copy-paste?
Maria: will update template. Also will reach out to the two enterprise customers with an incident summary + mitigation steps.
Jess: longer term tooling ask: dashboard that shows "open postmortem actions by owner" with SLA for action due dates and overdue counts. We should default to weekly email reminders for overdue items.
Sam: agree. The lambda can also schedule reminders by calling a notifications service. Add to backlog: dashboard + notification automation (P1).
Alex: last ask — can the bot add an oncall handoff note automatically into the thread when primary hands over? Right now handoffs often lose context.
eng-oncall-bot: plan: add automatic handoff note with summary, link to incident, and open actions. Will implement after tracker integration (phase 2).
Maria: all good. I'll schedule postmortem invite and attach current timeline + CS notes. Postmortem draft owner: Alex.
Sam: PR link placeholder: (will post)
Alex: thanks everyone. Quick wins: Jess to add alert, Maria to start customer outreach, Sam to prototype auto-ticket lambda. We'll review status in the postmortem + on the dashboard backlog. :thumbsup:
inc-bot: Incident INC-2029 status updated to "postmortem_scheduled" by Maria.
Jess: fetched. I'll create the dashboard ticket and link ACT-8423.
Maria: closing loop here — next messages will be in the postmortem doc. If you add anything to this thread, please prefix with "ACTION UPDATE" so it's easy to grep.
Alex: noted. ACTION UPDATE: I've started a branch with the runtime config change, link when ready.
